# Noto Sans JP

UI font of Virtual Vessel Studio (docs/en/ui/design-system.md, chapter 4).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Files | `NotoSansJP-Regular.ttf` (weight 400), `NotoSansJP-Bold.ttf` (weight 700) |
| Source | Google Fonts, static instances served by fonts.gstatic.com (`notosansjp/v57`) |
| Upstream | https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk |
| License | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`) |
| Retrieved | 2026-10-12 |

The files are not modified. Distributions include `OFL.txt`.
